t: You're standing in Hays Galleria, looking at The Navigators, a sculpture made in 1986 by David Kemp. Kemp is an artist born in 1945. The title points to people who find their way, and it sits well in a space beside the river. I don't have more about the figures themselves, so take a slow walk around the piece and see what it shows you. It is one of the artworks that give the Galleria its character.
